scope: 61st Venice Biennale 2026, In Minor Keys (artistic director Koyo Kouoh, completed by her team): main exhibition in the Arsenale and Central Pavilion (Giardini), plus national pavilions and notable collateral events. Sources read: ArtReview, The Art Newspaper, ARTnews, Hyperallergic, e-flux Criticism, Art Monthly, Kunstkritikk, The Nation, Wallpaper, ArchDaily, DailyArt, Whitewall, Art Basel, Wikipedia. frieze, artnet and Ocula returned 403; the stealthy fetcher did not start (missing browser), so those sites were not read.

exhibitions.name: 61st International Art Exhibition, La Biennale di Venezia: In Minor Keys
exhibitions.artistic_director: Koyo Kouoh (1967-2025), realised after her death by a team: Gabe Beckhurst Feijoo, Siddhartha Mitter, Marie Helene Pereira, Rasha Salti, Rory Tsapayi (La Squadra di Koyo)
exhibitions.title_metaphor: Kouoh used the minor key as both a musical mode (low, melancholy, sorrowful, yet also joyful and consoling) and as small islands or cays, an archipelago of oases or safe havens. The text asks for listening to the signals of earth and life, and gives free jazz as a working model.
sections: Arsenale (Corderie, Gaggiandre, Casetta Scaffali and gardens)
Indigo fabric thresholds by Wolff Architects
critic_notes: ArtReview calls the show quintessential biennial art: handsome, researched, diplomatic, a protest of fine print without demands.
The Art Newspaper (3.5 stars) praises sentinels, hybrid beings and procession in the Corderie but finds the Central Pavilion cramped and aimless.
Several critics say the hang is overstuffed and that the two lodestar artists' shrines are lost among other displays.
e-flux says there are too many works crammed in, with ethical atmosphere in place of precise argument.
The Nation finds the dominant look craftsy, accumulative and overproduced, like carnival floats, with wall texts that over-promise.
Kunstkritikk mocks the cult of plants and calls the focus on organic material a climate-art trope that drifts toward eco-political kitsch.
Art Monthly calls it rudderless, underdeveloped and overstuffed, and notes mawkish memorial excess in the portrait of Kouoh and Morrison.
Strong single works named across reviews: Sabsabi, Baudelaire, Rose Salane, Jaar, Raad, Smith, Nick Cave, Mutu.
Repeated formal types: hybrid human-animal-plant figures, clay vessels, beaded or feathered costume, herbaria, plants on columns, seated video lounges, banners with poems.
Hyperallergic reads the show as an unexpected symphony; Wallpaper calls it meditative, sensory and poetic.
Reviewers note the unusual share of new work and of living artists, and a strong presence of Africa and diaspora.

exhibitions.name: 61st Venice Biennale national pavilions and collateral events 2026
exhibitions.artistic_director: Not applicable (each pavilion has its own commissioner; main exhibition is by Koyo Kouoh's team)
exhibitions.title_metaphor: Pavilion titles are independent. Many borrow a poetic or proverb form (a pause, a ruin, grass and moon babies) and many answer the main theme of rest, listening and mourning.
critic_notes: Critics point to performance and live bodies (Austria, Belgium, Netherlands) as a defining trend.
Textile, clay and earth-built environments recur (Morocco, Peru, India, Saudi Arabia, Uzbekistan, Italy, Slovenia).
Sound and listening pavilions (Finland, Holy See, Cyprus, Poland, Qatar) are widely praised.
The US pavilion by Alma Allen is panned as bland, apolitical and expensive-looking.
German pavilion by Naumann and Tieu is repeatedly called one of the strongest.
The Nation says most pavilions are less inspiring than the main show.
The jury resigned before opening, so awards went to a public vote; a strike on 8 May closed or partly closed many pavilions.
Many commentators observe immersive-installation fatigue in the pavilions.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: khalil
works.medium_line: Eight-channel HD video installation with audio, acrylic paint on canvas, steel, black oud scent
works.what_you_see: A painted canvas about forty metres long is hung as a closed circle with the visitor inside. Negative images of crowd faces are projected over the abstract paint so that you cannot tell figure from ground. The room is dim, slow and scented, and it is the first work visitors meet after the poem at the Arsenale door.
nonvisual: scent: black oud
sound: multichannel audio, about 64 minutes
claims: Presented as a meeting point and healing space for conversation
Said to show that truth is collective and every person needs a witness
Described as a Sufi-informed treatment of inner and outer self and the divine
works.photo_notes: Press image caption gives full medium line; circular canvas room, dim, with projected crowd.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: The End, Where All began, EdEN
works.medium_line: Installation, dimensions variable
works.what_you_see: A single-artist room of earth, crystals, hovering animal forms and pregnant human figures. A knoll shaped like a pregnant body sits at the centre of the room (called MothersMound). A motorised broom turns slowly and sweeps coffee grounds into concentric circles while an animated film voices a mountain waking up.
nonvisual: sound: narration by the animated Kikuyu mother mountain
claims: Retells the Eden story with Mother Earth in place of a Father God
Described as a creation myth and a call to live in symbiosis with nature
works.photo_notes: Room-sized view credited to La Biennale; one of few rooms given to one artist.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Simbi Siren
works.medium_line: Bronze sculpture
works.what_you_see: A bronze hybrid figure, part mermaid, part sphinx, part tree root, lies draped over a perforated metal box. Water trickles from the fingertips down to flowers placed below. It stands outdoors near the harbour, close to the Nick Cave figure.
claims: Reimagines the Garden of Eden through an eco-feminist, African diasporic lens

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Amalgam (Origin)
works.medium_line: Monochrome bronze cast
works.what_you_see: A very large figure that mixes human, animal and plant, cast in one colour of bronze and standing in a power pose. Floral relief covers the body. From the chest up the body turns into a tree that holds a flock of about fifty bird species.
claims: The birds make a 'migration hub' that stands for community against oppression
Continues the Soundsuit project as a sign of resistance to racist violence

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Guardaverde
works.medium_line: Sculptural assemblage
works.what_you_see: A tall, staring figure built from debris collected on the streets of Loiza after a hurricane. It is one of three 'sentinels' placed through the show to keep watch. It stands alone with its gaze on the visitor.
claims: Acts as a guard and witness over the exhibition

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Amistad Takeover
works.medium_line: Black Masking beaded and feathered suit
works.what_you_see: A huge orange-feathered suit stands in the middle of the Central Pavilion entry room. Beadwork among the feathers shows the 19th-century revolt of enslaved people on a Spanish ship. Another beadwork costume stands next to it.
nonvisual: performance: the suits are linked to Mardi Gras processions
claims: Honours the Black Masking Indian tradition and the joy of procession

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.venue_room: Giardini, Central Pavilion, facade and columns
works.title: Soft Offerings to Silenced Voices and to All Who Have Turned to Dust
works.medium_line: Brick, plants, glass and ceramic installation on building columns
works.what_you_see: The four white cylindrical columns at the entrance to the Central Pavilion are clad in bricks made locally. Glass terraria, clay flower pots, wooden bee hotels, climbing vines and translucent Murano glass ovoids hang on them. The plants are expected to cover the columns by November.
claims: Rewilds modernist architecture
Offered to the silenced and the dead
works.photo_notes: Press photo caption places it at the entrance to the Central Pavilion.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: ICE Age Disease Thrower
works.medium_line: Sculptures from the Disease Thrower series
works.what_you_see: A group of sculptures built on woven, body-shaped chairs that recall Acapulco chairs and Mayan hammocks. Found objects sit in the chairs, including a beanie with animal ears that copies one worn by a detained child. Each piece reads as a small altar.
claims: Called both shrines and healing instruments by the artist
Act as witnesses to and guards against border brutality

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Black Ifa 1-5
works.medium_line: Stoneware vessels on wooden stools
works.what_you_see: A ring of lopsided stoneware vessels sits on wooden stools. The unglazed clay was fired past its normal temperature, so the surfaces crack and the forms fold into themselves. The vessels look about to collapse.
claims: Vessels act as votive offerings, totems and conduits
Named after the Yoruba divination system Ifa
works.photo_notes: Hung near the large suspended photo roll by Carrie Schneider in the same hall.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: The Council of the Mother Spirits of the Animals
works.medium_line: Coil-built, pre-fire slip-painted clay with vegetal resins
works.what_you_see: A group of hand-built clay figures with slip paint and plant resin, shown in a prominent place in the Giardini. They stand as a council of animal mother spirits.
claims: Offers a spiritual understanding of ecology

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: The End of the World
works.medium_line: Red-lit installation with a mineral cube
works.what_you_see: A room in intense red light with a church-like plan. Text blocks on the red walls list the metals and minerals behind phones and weapons. At the far end a small cube of ten metals and rare earths sits on a plinth in a vitrine.
claims: Exposes the extraction of cobalt, lithium, coltan and copper
A critic notes the cube would be among the most valuable objects at the Biennale
works.photo_notes: Press photo shows a tall saturated red room; ArtReview says it can look like a red-light therapy room.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Postscript to the Arabic Edition
works.medium_line: Freight pallets carrying painted copies of missing artworks
works.what_you_see: Wooden freight pallets are decorated with copies of famous Turkish and Arab paintings. A wall text says the pallets moved arms from Lebanon to Yugoslav states after 1990 and carried art that escaped destruction. Whether the story is true is left open.
claims: A fictional framing story about weapons moving from one war to the next

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: far from quieting
works.medium_line: Eleven trompe-l'oeil paintings on wood
works.what_you_see: Eleven small painted panels copy stock photographs of bedrooms. A short text says Yasser Arafat slept in each. The narrator may be unreliable, and the show makes that part of the point.
claims: Teaches the viewer to question how history is narrated

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.medium_line: Textiles with preparatory drawings on paper
works.what_you_see: Textiles are shown on a sloping platform that lifts them out of the clutter of the pavilion. Rows and patterns change in small steps. A second display on the floor above shows preparatory sketches that look like musical scores built on a grid.
claims: Critic says improvised-looking forms are held by a strict grid, like jazz and blues
works.photo_notes: Title of the textile works is not given in the source.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.venue_room: Giardini and Arsenale, shown in several spaces
works.title: No Shelter
works.medium_line: Patchwork textile collages and watercolours (series No Shelter 12-29)
works.what_you_see: Small collages made of discarded paper and fabric, and linked watercolours, look abstract at first and then read as the architecture and land of Gaza. They are split between several rooms instead of one solo room.
claims: Rebuts the destruction of Gaza by adding colour
works.photo_notes: Critic says the pieces were scattered; a solo room would have given them space.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Let This Be My Cathedral
works.medium_line: Wall-based herbarium
works.what_you_see: A wall-sized herbarium of pressed plants from the artist's own garden on a former plantation in Barbados. It is built as a place of refuge and thought.
claims: Designed as a haven for introspection and for thinking about the ethics of botanical ecologies

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Anatomy of the Magnolia Tree for Koyo Kouoh and Toni Morrison
works.medium_line: Eight-panel painted portrait with glass and resin floral sculptures and sound
works.what_you_see: A mural-size painting across eight vertical panels shows the curator and the writer with bird-of-prey talons for feet, among magnolia leaves and blooms. Resin and PLA flower sculptures stand near it, with a soft soundscape. Critics call it a memorial shrine.
nonvisual: sound: soundscape by Kamaal Malak, hard to hear
claims: Memorial to Kouoh, with Toni Morrison as literary patron

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Untitled (Spirit Jar)
works.medium_line: Tin can with bottle caps, licence plate, hair ties and beads
works.what_you_see: A tin can is covered with bottle caps, a crumpled licence plate, hair ties and plastic beads. It sits near small wooden shack models that have family names scrawled on the siding. The display is one of two 'shrines' to patron-saint artists.
claims: Reads like a reliquary of discarded everyday objects

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: ...fester...
works.medium_line: Jacquard floral fabric with glitter, lace and beads
works.what_you_see: Dozens of yards of floral jacquard are layered with glitter, lace and beads in a dense jungle-like mass. The back reveals a mound of red-painted hands with black thorns growing through. Critics single out its dense accumulation.
claims: Beauty of Caribbean scenes hides a brutal colonial history

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Garden of the Broken Hearted
works.medium_line: Living olive tree on a rotating platform with video
works.what_you_see: A large olive tree from an undisclosed location stands on a slowly turning platform, and a video of the tree is projected on it. It carries scars of conflict but is alive.
claims: Once a place of rest and gathering, now scarred

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Temple of Passages
works.medium_line: Installation of scented flowers on maritime rope
works.what_you_see: Very large garlands of scented flowers hang from the ceiling on ship rope in the old Arsenale rope hall. The flowers decay during the show and host micro-organisms. The ropes recall the work once done in that building.
nonvisual: scent: flowers, changing as they decay
claims: Described elsewhere as an ephemeral temple for decaying beings

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.venue_room: In Minor Keys (venue room not stated)
works.title: Mantra
works.medium_line: Ceramic seeds
works.what_you_see: A quiet installation of ceramic copies of the seeds of a Palestinian field plant. A wall label explains that the plant grows in vineyards and olive groves and that British Mandate officials listed it as a weed to be wiped out.
claims: Turns a labelled weed into a quiet monument

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.venue_room: Arsenale, Corderie, end of the hall
works.title: Tougaloo
works.medium_line: Curved slabs of graphite and acrylic with cavities holding glass chunks
works.what_you_see: Tall curved architectural slabs in dark grey stand in parallel rows. Cavities in the slabs hold rough chunks of glass and vertical shards. The viewer walks between the arcs and cannot see the work from one spot.
claims: Named after a Mississippi former plantation and college, from a Choctaw word meaning between two streams

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: The Wanda Coleman Songbook
works.medium_line: Four-channel video, vinyl EP, scent, console, books, carpets, seating
works.what_you_see: Four large screens stand round a seating area with sofas and blankets. They show Los Angeles streets, the Watts Towers, a police helicopter and a gym. Seven musical settings of a poet's work play. Books lie open in a vitrine.
nonvisual: sound: seven musical interpretations of the poet's work
scent: listed in the medium line
claims: Turns historical suffering into joy through poetry and music
works.photo_notes: Reviewers describe it as a laid-back lounge in the middle of a crowded hall.

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Panorama 94
works.medium_line: Shadowbox display of found rings with texts
works.what_you_see: Found rings sit in a shadowbox. Each has a short line of text from a psychic who was asked to sense its former owner. The lines read as small blunt eulogies.
claims: Mixes enchantment with a cheeky tone

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Death Passed My Way and Stuck this Flower in my Mouth
works.medium_line: Five-channel video with six-channel audio, 25:25 minutes
works.what_you_see: Five screens show gloved workers sorting yellow flowers in a Dutch auction warehouse. Pages of a 1922 play hang on the wall nearby. An elegant man who may be Death speaks about observing life.
nonvisual: sound: six-channel audio
claims: Experience of love is sharpened by the fact of loss

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Dedication II
works.medium_line: Flat screens on the floor and vibrating wooden platform
works.what_you_see: Flat screens lie vertically on the floor and show forest-floor close-ups and tree roots, with poem lines that flash up. A wooden platform vibrates to suggest the movement of the ground. Related garden walks name the plants outside.
nonvisual: sound and vibration: platform hums with the ground
performance: visitors read aloud to plants (Reveries of Collective Walkers)
claims: Treats plants as agents that move with humans

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.venue_room: In Minor Keys (venue room not stated)
works.title: Lovers' Vigil
works.medium_line: Matchboxes with tiny paintings inside an open-frame room
works.what_you_see: Mohammed Z. Rahman builds an open-frame room within the hall where visitors sit and look at tiny paintings of heartbreak symbols on matchboxes. A nearby crate is painted to look like a pack of condoms.
claims: Lilies, chrysanthemums and cherry blossoms stand for grief

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - In Minor Keys (main exhibition)
works.title: Crowds and Insects
works.medium_line: Oil on board
works.what_you_see: A small painting of an army of insects marching past a self-important leader. It was made when critics of Idi Amin were jailed. One critic says the veil is nearly transparent.
claims: Seen as a veiled attack on authoritarianism, shown in a capsule of Nairobi Contemporary Art Institute painting

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: May your tears never dry, you who weep over stones
works.medium_line: Mud and clay floor mosaics
works.what_you_see: Visitors walk on a floor of thousands of handmade mud tiles laid out as 23 lost mosaics from Palestine, Syria and Lebanon. Gravel crunches underfoot. The tiles were dried in the sun with no binder and have already started to crack.
claims: Cracks stand for the fragility of the sites
Suggests both continuity of making and constant destruction

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Human Dignity Shall Be Inviolable
works.medium_line: Trompe-l'oeil mosaic on the pavilion facade
works.what_you_see: The front of the neoclassical pavilion is wrapped in a mosaic of about three million tesserae. It shows the balconied windows of a prefabricated East Berlin housing block, once home to contract workers from abroad, now due for demolition. Inside, small aluminium ladybirds crowd the corners.
claims: Title quotes Article 1 of the German Basic Law

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: The Home Front
works.medium_line: Sculptural assemblage of domestic objects
works.what_you_see: Walls are painted a minty green copied from East German army barracks. A grid of small domestic objects lines them, including toys, chairs, portraits, an axe and a hoe. Midcentury chairs cut in half are fixed to the wall as if sinking into the marble.
claims: The artist called the objects hieroglyphics

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Grass Babies, Moon Babies
works.medium_line: Installation with about 200 baby dolls
works.what_you_see: Hundreds of heavy baby dolls in reflective sunglasses crawl, climb scaffolding and hang from ropes. Visitors pick one up at random and carry it through the garden and building. A changing station gives each doll a QR-linked diaper poem tied to a birthday.
nonvisual: sound: voices of the artist's twin babies
claims: Gives weight to care, war and declining birth rates

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Seaworld Venice
works.medium_line: Performance installation with water tanks, portable toilets and nude performers
works.what_you_see: The listed building becomes a sewage plant and tank. Visitors use two portable toilets, and the urine flows through the rooms as the water for nude performers. A jet ski, a metal climbing shaft and a person who rings a huge bell as the clapper add to it.
nonvisual: sound: giant bell
performance: nude performers living in the pavilion
claims: Complicates purity and pollution, sin and expiation
Extends Viennese Actionism

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Asetta
works.medium_line: Monumental woven textile installation made with about 150 weavers
works.dimensions: made with about 150 weavers, mostly women
works.what_you_see: Large textiles rise and fold in mid-air under high ceilings to form a floating doorway. A hum, rain, a car horn and the clack of a loom play in the room. Visitors are told not to touch.
nonvisual: sound: a man humming, rain, loom clicks
claims: Craft is described as cutting edge, not backward-looking

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Entre chien et loup
works.medium_line: Wardian case installation with a pond and living water lilies
works.what_you_see: The building becomes a greenhouse. Steam mists the windows. A large reflective pond holds giant Victoria water lilies; a related description mentions grow lights.
claims: Links imperial plant collecting, world fairs and biennials

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Con te con tutto
works.medium_line: Installation of 24 terracotta and stoneware figures, and a garden room
works.what_you_see: A dim first room holds 24 columns and figures the artist calls minor deities, made of rough terracotta, glazed stoneware, ash and soil, with real and fake flowers and hair. In a second room, windows and doors stand open. Wooden furniture-like pieces and seats face a garden.
claims: Highlights slowness and dialogue between forms of life

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Aeolian Suite
works.medium_line: Five sonic-kinetic sculptures with a 16-minute score
works.what_you_see: Five sculptures stand in a circle like a wind rose in the Aalto pavilion. Each is covered with long fuzzy wigs that copy microphone wind covers. They blow and sing as the five Venetian winds.
nonvisual: sound: wind machines, recorders, children's woodwind orchestra, field recordings
claims: Asks what counts as noise

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Passer
works.medium_line: Animatronic papier-mache sparrow, copper cylinders, recreated ceiling and sound
works.what_you_see: A papier-mache sparrow ticks like a metronome from a clock in its open belly. A wooden ceiling copies that of a ruined nightclub. At the back, copper cylinders turn in an uneven row on the floor and make only their own whirring sound.
nonvisual: sound: songs by the artist's family, mixed by Panagiotis Mina

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Bearing
works.medium_line: Wall work of about 4,000 wax-coated organza circles
works.what_you_see: A membrane-like wall of about 4,000 organza circles coated in wax, layered like scales or leaves, divides the room. It suggests a womb or a sanctuary. Metal rods by a second artist pass through the same space.
claims: Liberation and community presented as actions, not objects

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Soundtrack for an Invisible House
works.medium_line: Crushed rubble and mirrors with soundscape
works.what_you_see: The room is filled with the crushed remains of the previous Architecture Biennale. Mirrors at either end make the heaps seem endless. Visitors sit among concrete debris.
nonvisual: sound: four-language polyphony, birdsong, wind and water
claims: Reuses one exhibition as the ground of the next

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: From Other Worlds
works.medium_line: Large paintings on raw cotton, sculptures covered in painted gauze, film
works.what_you_see: Paintings of kene patterns on natural-dyed cotton hang in the room beside sculptures of painted gauze. An insect drone and birdsong fill the pavilion.
nonvisual: sound: cicadas and birdsong
claims: Kene is described by the artist as a practice of repair

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Don't Get Me Wrong
works.medium_line: 26 acrylic-on-canvas panels
works.what_you_see: Twenty-six panels run along 45 metres of wall. They are raised more than two metres off the floor and pulled away from the wall, so viewers feel distance and effort. Lighting is soft.
claims: Asks viewers to think about humans, nature and the cosmos

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Comme Saturne
works.medium_line: Dyed and de-voured wool textiles and machines
works.what_you_see: Rooms are draped in huge wool hangings, some made by burning away part of the fibre. Daylight slowly fades the dyes. Machines stall and repeat. The catalogue opens with a glossary of textile terms that double as emotions.
nonvisual: scent: strong smell of wool
claims: Words for textile processes slide into words for feeling

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Things to Come
works.medium_line: Film projected on a curved wall
works.what_you_see: A film set in a cryogenic sperm lab staffed by porn performers plays on the curved wall. Sperm transport containers sit in niches like relics. Baby photographs line clean corridors.
claims: Imagines pornography and fertility science merged

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: The Fortress
works.medium_line: Performance and architectural installation
works.what_you_see: Through the day, steel shutters close slowly between the buttresses of the Rietveld pavilion. The sunlit modernist building turns into a dark fortress, and performers sing a score that uses only their false vocal cords.
nonvisual: performance: vocal composition by performers, harsh like sandpaper (artist interview in ArtReview)

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.title: Escape Room
works.medium_line: Immersive installation with LED floor, 21 m screen and soft sculptures
works.what_you_see: Neon lights, a light-up floor and a 21-metre screen fill the pavilion, with soft columns slumped on the floor. A second area is a kiosk selling plush books and 3D-printed trinkets.
nonvisual: sound: a pop song on a loop
claims: Nation described as a performance like drag

works.exhibition: 61st Venice Biennale 2026 - national pavilions and collateral events
works.venue_room: Belarus Free Theatre, Chiesa di San Giovanni Evangelista (collateral)
works.title: Official. Unofficial. Belarus.
works.medium_line: Group show with wheat field, rebar amulets and a scent
works.what_you_see: A field of wheat made by former political prisoners rises from a bed of soil. Above it hang diamond-shaped rebar amulets and metal straw spiders. A cross made of CCTV cameras and a confession booth that runs facial recognition fill the church.
nonvisual: scent: a warm August afternoon at a village cemetery, by ol.factory
sound: prisoner testimonies read by actors
claims: Counts as the first independent contribution from Belarus
